description: Round 1 castle shaft: a ladder jump (PgUp), then Up held to the castle top and the end screen (ega/099-101; ega_castle_ladder_jump_top.avi fits these keys within a tick)

masks.reason: the castle-top tick clears g_keyState; DOSBox-X redraws the clue box only when that tick lands between a frame's Frame_Begin and its Screen_DrawOverlay (1 of 5 reference runs: ega_r2_end_t2_nokey); the engine's lockstep order (Frame_Begin, Game_Tick, frame body) always takes that path, so its key icon is gone where most captures still show it

the castle-top tick clears g_keyState; DOSBox-X redraws the clue box only when that tick lands between a frame's Frame_Begin and its Screen_DrawOverlay (1 of 5 reference runs: ega_r2_end_t2_nokey); the engine's lockstep order (Frame_Begin, Game_Tick, frame body) always takes that path, so its key icon is gone where most captures still show it

avi_fits.note: 1.2 ticks at the castle-top transition: DOSBox-X shows the shaft until the transition frame has loaded CLOSE and drawn, the engine from its start
